name: Functional Adaptive Shrinkage (FASH)
model_likelihood: Independent Gaussian estimated effects conditional on effect functions and supplied standard errors
prior: Shared iid functional prior: mixture of L-GPs on a fixed scale grid including the null baseline
inference_algorithm: Marginal-likelihood mixture fitting with optional Dirichlet penalty and sequential quadratic programming; component GP computation via finite elements
estimand: Posterior mean effect functions; local false discovery and false sign rates
data_input: Effect estimates, standard errors and continuous condition values for many units
tunable_settings: Differential operator L and baseline Null(L); scale grid including sigma_0=0; Dirichlet lambda values (default lambda_0=10, others 1); number of O-splines (default 20)
component_claims: model_likelihood=fash:c03; prior=fash:c04; prior=fash:c06; inference_algorithm=fash:c07; inference_algorithm=fash:c09; estimand=fash:c08; data_input=fash:c02

name: Linear differential operator Gaussian process (L-GP)
model_likelihood: Inherited Gaussian measurement model when used as a component in FASH
prior: L beta = sigma xi with Gaussian white noise; baseline Null(L); L=D^p gives an integrated Wiener process
inference_algorithm: Finite element approximation exploiting Markov structure, using 20 equally spaced O-splines by default
estimand: Component posterior effect functions; IWP posterior mean coincides with a smoothing spline estimator
data_input: Effect estimates, standard errors and condition values in the FASH observation model
tunable_settings: Differential operator L; deviation scale sigma; number of O-splines
